trigger.label: Trigger
trigger.doc: Flow'ni boshlovchi yoki javob kutuvchi hodisalar: /command, xabar (matn/rasm/kontakt), inline/reply tugma, cron jadval.

send.label: Send
send.doc: Foydalanuvchiga xabar va media yuborish: matn, rasm, video, audio, hujjat, stiker, lokatsiya, kontakt, animatsiya.

edit.label: Edit
edit.doc: Oldin yuborilgan xabarni tahrirlash yoki o'chirish (matn, inline tugma), edit-or-send.

flow_control.label: Flow control
flow_control.doc: Oqim mantig'i: shart (if), tarmoqlanish, sikl (for-loop), kutish, kanal a'zoligini tekshirish, sub-flow chaqirish.

data.label: Data
data.doc: Ma'lumot bilan ishlash: MongoDB collection (yaratish/o'qish/yozish/o'chirish) va state (o'zgaruvchi saqlash).

integration.label: Integration
integration.doc: Tashqi xizmatlar: HTTP so'rov, Google Sheets/Drive, fayl yuklash, custom JavaScript kod.

interaction.label: Interaction
interaction.doc: Foydalanuvchidan ma'lumot so'rash: matn, kontakt/telefon, tugma orqali tanlov.

subflow.label: Subflow
subflow.doc: Sub-flow kirish/chiqish nuqtalari — flow'ni qayta ishlatiladigan bo'laklarga bo'lish.

payment.label: Payment
payment.doc: To'lov qabul qilish: PaymentNode (Click/Paycue), Telegram invoice, va AI agent uchun to'lov havolasi/status tool'lari.

ai.label: AI
ai.doc: AI agent (LLM), provider sub-node'lar (Ollama/OpenAI/Gemini/Anthropic) va AI tool'lar (HTTP, collection, custom code, knowledge/RAG, sana, Google Sheets). structuredOutput bilan JSON.
